items.claim: Jovon Lake wants to make up for not getting a contract on the Contender Series.
items.quote: I think he wants to make up for his wrongdoings on the contender series where he didn't get a contract.

items.claim: Boris Lav Nicolich is extremely tough and comes forward relentlessly.
items.quote: This guy is as tough as nails. He's going to come forward like a zombie.

items.claim: Boris Lav Nicolich will have a massive height and reach advantage.
items.quote: He's gonna have a massive height and reach advantage in this fight.

items.claim: Mark Velogden is too small for bantamweight and should probably be fighting at flyweight.
items.quote: Mark Belgden's a guy that he's just not a bantamweight. You know, he's he's a guy that probably should be fighting at flyweight.

items.claim: Mark Velogden has taken a massive amount of damage in his recent fights.
items.quote: this guy has taken like years off his life in these last two fights getting hurt a ton, eating a ton of, you know, big shots.

items.claim: Boris Lav Nicolich has a ton of power and an opportunistic submission game.
items.quote: Nicolich, he's going to make you pay. If you're hitable, he's going to make you pay. He has a ton of power, a very opportunistic submission game.
